name: LaTeXBench
description: LaTeXBench is a compact, judge-only benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' abilities in LaTeX generation, minimal-edit compliance, and blind contrast error detection. It measures structural validity, precise constraint adherence, and fault awareness in LaTeX document generation and editing.
evaluation_method: automatic scoring via LLM judge with JSON outputs and Wilson binomial intervals
reputation: A compact, judge-only benchmark that has gained attention for testing practical LaTeX generation and editing behaviors with minimal-edit constraints.
notes: Focuses on structure-aware abilities in LaTeX generation and editing; scoring is fully automatic and judge-only.
